title: 有馬記念の後に・アタシは強い

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Narita Taishin rises above her powerful classic and senior competitors and triumphs at the Arima Kinen.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Her rivals, the audience, and I—we all cheer for her as one.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Despite her small stature, she leaves the biggest mark of anyone at the race.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: With an undeniably beaming smile, Narita Taishin stands atop the winner's circle.
